title: Netskope Secure Web Gateway (SWG) Deployment & Web Filtering
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (inline SWG across Netskope + identity + endpoints; web-filtering policy, traffic steering, live-traffic risk).
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: Put every user's web traffic behind one cloud secure web gateway
problem: Web traffic is where most threats and data loss start, yet many organizations still rely on patchy filtering that remote users bypass entirely. This solution stands up the Netskope Secure Web Gateway (SWG) as a cloud-delivered chokepoint for web traffic — URL categorization, web-filtering policy, threat and content controls, and consistent enforcement on or off the corporate network — deployed safely with a pilot-first, rollback-ready method.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how a cloud SWG works, traffic steering into Netskope, URL categorization and web-filtering policy, threat/content controls, and the on/off-network enforcement model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a Netskope tenant + SWG, Entra ID identity, Intune for client/cert delivery, DNS/egress, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm tenant and identity, define web-filtering and categorization policy, steer pilot traffic, validate enforcement and user experience, then pilot, validate, and expand fleet-wide.
5 PowerShell scripts — SWG-readiness discovery, client/steering validation, a web-traffic and policy-coverage report, safe remediation of mis-steered devices, and a target group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Stand up the Netskope Secure Web Gateway as a cloud chokepoint for web traffic — URL categorization, web-filtering policy, and consistent enforcement on or off network — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
